_about: Art settings read by tools/art/art.py. style: "default" is the fallback pack in styles/default; any other value is a path to a style pack directory. sizes: one row per picture kind, with the drawing size in cm, the exact PNG size in pixels, whether the background is transparent, which edges a cutout must leave clear (t, b, l, r), and the file size cap in bytes. out: the folder the PNGs go to (default web/art); this project uses data/img/art because the boundary test reads every file under web/ as text (R2.2).
